text: Magento - Environments is a module designed to manage different environments such as development, staging, and pre-production.
The module automatically updates values in core_config_data, ensuring correct settings for web/unsecure/base_url and other configurations.
The project was created by Tobias Forkel.
The funding goal for the project was $4,236.
$635 was pledged to the project.
The funding period for the project was from December 7, 2015, to December 28, 2015.
The project funding was unsuccessful.
The project was last updated on January 5, 2016.
Magento - Environments provides functionalities accessible in Admin > System > Environments.
Magento - Environments provides functionalities available in Admin > System > Environments.
Magento - Environments includes filters like Configuration, Environments, and Scopes (Global, Website, Store).
All filter options in Magento - Environments are generated dynamically based on data from core_config_data.
Magento - Environments features a grid table that allows comparison and setting of different values in core_config_data for Development, Staging, or Pre-Production environments.
Magento - Environments includes a snapshot functionality that shows a history of all changes made in System > Configuration.
The snapshot functionality in Magento - Environments displays detailed information with a timestamp and username.
With Magento - Environments, users can add or delete as many servers as needed.
Magento - Environments works with a permanently synced copy of core_config_data to allow reverting changes to their original value.
A method called sync in Magento - Environments performs actions when the host name matches one of the servers in Admin > System > Environments > Server.
Magento - Environments works with a permanently synced copy of core_config_data.
A method called sync will perform actions when the host name matches with one of the servers in Admin > System > Environments > Server.
If a host name doesn't match with any entry in Admin > System > Environments > Server, Magento - Environments will not make any changes in core_config_data.
